authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong material coherence with consistent wood grain across all carved objects (horses, lions, table, candlesticks). Lighting is physically plausible with appropriate shadows and highlights on the wooden surfaces. However, several artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) Candle flames are unnaturally uniform in shape, size, and brightness across all six candles - a classic AI repetition artifact. (2) Minor fusion/melting at contact points where lion paws meet their pedestals and where horse hooves meet the ground plane, lacking crisp shadow separation. (3) The fine_grained_classifier failed to recognize horses (predicted 'Indian elephant') and lions (predicted 'barrel'), indicating the stylized carvings lack sufficient biological fidelity for standard classifiers, though they remain recognizable as horses/lions to human observers. These issues suggest moderate generation quality but do not constitute severe structural collapse.
